content: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?

args.sql:
SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, SUM(res.points) as total_points
FROM f1.main.results res
JOIN f1.main.races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
WHERE r.year >= 2001
GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
ORDER BY r.year, total_points ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT constructor_id
FROM f1.main.results res
JOIN f1.main.races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
WHERE r.year = 2001 AND res.driver_id = 50;

WITH driver_season_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, SUM(res.points) as total_points

    WHERE r.year >= 2001

    HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
),
min_points_per_season AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM driver_season_points
    GROUP BY year
),
lowest_drivers AS (
    SELECT dsp.year, dsp.driver_id, dsp.total_points
    FROM driver_season_points dsp
    JOIN min_points_per_season mps ON dsp.year = mps.year AND dsp.total_points = mps.min_points
)

    FROM f1.main.results res
    JOIN f1.main.races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = 2010
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
    HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
)
SELECT * FROM driver_season_points ORDER BY total_points ASC LIMIT 5;
